title: Runner: startup stage events and a startup benchmark script (PERF-3)

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The earlier six-case run failed three warning-capture assertions despite emitted warnings. A fixture-only correction now captures warning records from stream three without changing product source or weakening sentinel and snapshot assertions. The separately assigned focused run under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Pester 3.4 executed once with privileged symlink opt-in disabled: five passed, zero failed, one skipped and none pending. All three junction cases actually executed and passed, including their sentinel and snapshot assertions. Source pins matched and transcript, XML and individual results are retained. The single validation lock was released without retry. This is a focused candidate-fixture pass, not product-source validation or review convergence; final finding grounding, literal-suggestion coverage, current review/thread accounting and any remaining exact-upstream build gates are still required.
